1.title: What type of vehicle is it?
1.subtitle: California Lemon Law covers new, certified pre-owned, and many used vehicles.

2.title: Did the defect first occur during the original manufacturer warranty?
2.subtitle: That is the question that matters. An 18-month / 18,000-mile timeline is not required to have a case.

3.title: How many times has the same defect been repaired?
3.subtitle: Count only repair visits for the identical problem (e.g. transmission, electrical, engine).
3.hint: Count only visits for the identical problem.

4.title: Total days out of service for repairs?
4.subtitle: Add up every day the vehicle sat at the dealer or shop for warranty repairs.
4.hint: Add every day the vehicle sat at the dealer for warranty repairs.

5.title: Does the defect impair the vehicle's use, value, or safety?
5.subtitle: A substantial impairment is part of a Song-Beverly claim.

6.title: Is it a safety-related defect?
6.subtitle: A defect likely to cause death or serious injury (brakes, steering, airbags, stalling, fire risk) can strengthen a claim with fewer repair visits.
